'''Ilex''' was a [[Nomai]] who grew up on [[Brittle Hollow]] and [[Ember Twin]].

==Life on Ember Twin==
In the [[Sunless City]], they played the [[Anglerfish]] game with [[Laevi]], [[Lami]], [[Taget]], and [[Solanum]].<ref>ILEX: Remember to feed the fossil fish first! If you go to the Anglerfish Overlook and throw a light into his mouth, he’ll show you the way.</ref> Ilex was the tallest child out of all of them.<ref>LAEVI: Who cares? Ilex is still tallest.</ref> Ilex wanted the older children to wear blindfolds in the game to make it more scientifically accurate, as Anglerfish are blind.<ref>ILEX: Rule update: It’s okay if younger kids don’t wear the blindfold when they’re it. (The rest of us will still wear it for scientific accuracy and to make the game more even.)</ref>

==Life on Brittle Hollow==
During the [[Ash Twin Project]]'s construction, Ilex went to school in the [[Hanging City]].<ref>ILEX: We might have to build a smaller Vessel for now, even though Vessels are normally large. But we could make it bigger later once we reach planets with more resources. ILEX: It would also help if we stopped building so many things to search for the Eye of the universe. I asked Yarrow, and he says we use lots of resources on the Ash Twin Project.</ref> They wrote an essay on why they believed that a new [[Vessel]] should be built.<ref>ILEX: Why We Should Build A New Vessel</ref> [[Coleus]] told Ilex that the Nomai used to meet other clans and learned from them, [[Poke]] told them about her plans to make an [[Advanced Warp Core]], and [[Yarrow]] explained that the Nomai use a lot of resources on the Ash Twin Project.<ref>ILEX: We could even meet with other Nomai, and learn from them, like Coleus says we used to do.</ref><ref>ILEX: We could even have a warp core for jumping long distances like Vessels have. Poke tells me she plans to make a very advanced warp core for a different project. I’m sure she could connect it to the Vessel for travel (because Poke is smart).</ref><ref name=eye>ILEX: It would also help if we stopped building so many things to search for the Eye of the universe. I asked Yarrow, and he says we use lots of resources on the Ash Twin Project.</ref> This led Illex to believe that the Nomai should stop building things to search for the [[Eye of the Universe]] and instead build a new Vessel.<ref name=eye/>

Ilex also visited the [[Brittle_Hollow#Old_Settlement|Old Settlement]] on Brittle Hollow at some point, where they left a poem about being cautious of the [[Black Hole]] at Brittle Hollow's center.<ref>ILEX: Look out, look out below! ILEX: Look out for the gravity hole! ILEX: For should you slip ILEX: And lose your grip, ILEX: Then into space you go!</ref> Ilex passed away after the [[Ghost Matter]] from the [[Interloper]] instantly spread throughout the [[Solar System]], which killed all Nomai. It is unclear where Ilex's remains are located.

== Trivia ==

* ''[[Wikipedia:Holly|Ilex]]'' is another name for the Holly genus of flowering plants.
